driver: STM32N6 serial peripheral interface (SPI1) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 67 (SPI) + memory map p.180
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.67 SPI register interface + memory map p.180 (SPI1 secure base 0x52003000)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the SPI benchmark work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure SPI1 (stm32n6xx.h)

Enable/disable and enable status (SPI_CR1.SPE); while disabled: master/slave mode (SPI_CFG2.MASTER), clock phase and polarity (SPI_CFG2.CPHA, CPOL), bit order (SPI_CFG2.LSBFRST), baud rate prescaler (SPI_CFG1.MBR with its bypass SPI_CFG1.BPASS), frame size (SPI_CFG1.DSIZE), FIFO threshold (SPI_CFG1.FTHLV), slave select management (SPI_CFG2.SSM with SPI_CFG2.SSOE)

Transfer size (SPI_CR2.TSIZE) and master transfer start (SPI_CR1.CSTART); status flags RXP, TXP, EOT, TXC, OVR (SPI_SR) and clearing EOT and OVR (SPI_IFCR); 8-bit frame write (SPI_TXDR) and read (SPI_RXDR) (no waiting: the caller bounds its polling)

Out of scope: HAL API, half-duplex direction and communication mode (SPI_CR1.HDDIR, SPI_CFG2.COMM), CRC, TI mode, I2S/PCM, interrupts, DMA, suspend, underrun, IO swap, GPIO control, 16/32-bit frames, the LL init/deinit functions of stm32n6xx_ll_spi.c

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 015 benchmark set (owner 2026-10-25): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 SPI LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects SPI1_S at 0x52003000).

scope.note: enable/disable, configuration while disabled, transfer size and master start, status flags and flag clears, 8-bit data
